acceptance_plan.reference_acceptance: Evaluation mean SDR increases and bass/body/attack complex error and flux error, spectral deficit/excess, vocal projection power, conditional artifact residual all decrease vs previous V2.
acceptance_plan.ezo_acceptance: For the frozen 39 low-voice windows, bass/body/attack spectral deficit and flux error do not increase; full-record same-model residual voice RMS does not increase. No clipping or timebase change.
acceptance_plan.limits: Reused local reference excerpts, proxy-biased Ezo selection, no subjective listening; cannot establish clear audible superiority or true Ezo zero-loss/leakage.

reference.development_constraints: No increase in mean conditional artifact residual or mean vocal projection power against previous V2; simplex and smoothness regularization.
